description: This file manages clock configurations for Intel ADSP hardware within Zephyr OS, including setting CPU frequencies, initializing clock sources, and handling clock source info.

methods.name: select_cpu_clock_hw
methods.description: Selects the hardware clock frequency based on index.

methods.name: adsp_clock_set_cpu_freq
methods.description: Sets the CPU frequency index for all CPUs.

methods.name: adsp_cpu_clocks_get
methods.description: Returns the current CPU clock info array.

methods.name: adsp_clock_source_is_supported
methods.description: Checks if a clock source is supported.

methods.name: adsp_clock_source_frequency
methods.description: Returns the frequency of a given clock source.
